title: Structural Relations among Physical Constants
subtitle: Action, Geometric Reciprocity, and Memory of Transformations
body: The monograph develops compatibility between action, mass, propagation, and information, and the recovery of their constitutive relations. Starting from APP–TRIT–TPK, orientation and memory transmit common conditions to readings that appear independent when expressed solely as values. In the normalized constitutive domain, propagation speed and the Barbero–Immirzi functional allow the labelled spectrum of two channels to be recovered. Speed and impedance are linked through a spectral potential whose curvature determines reconstruction sensitivity and connects with the oriented Catalan moment. The composition of elliptic transformations restores the dimensionless action coefficient and records the order of operations even when the phase returns. Vacancies and memory re-entry distinguish chronological information, the present balance, and response capacity. Under the stated circular and thermal conditions, a mass coordinate relates proper frequency, reciprocal lengths, and thermal weighting. Production, compatibility, and restoration bring together the determinations of the constants, preserving the domains and dimensional references of each construction. The marked length and memory complement complete the gravitational connection. The action–gravitation product preserves area, while constitutive reconstruction recovers the oriented Catalan function; these operations make the joint dependence of the constants explicit.
